findings.note_span: Clobetasone butyrate 0.05% once daily to inflamed areas on the body for 7 days, then hydrocortisone 1% if needed.
findings.transcript_evidence: Clobetasone butyrate, 0.05 percent. Put it on the red patches on her body once a day for seven days, then go back to the hydrocortisone for a few days if needed.
findings.rationale: The plan omits the instruction to return to hydrocortisone for a few days if needed, which is a key part of the prescribed management.

findings.note_span: Epaderm 3–4 times daily and as a soap substitute (at least 500 g every 2 weeks). Stop bubble baths.
findings.transcript_evidence: Use the Epaderm three or four times a day, lots of it, at least a 500 gram tub every two weeks. Use it instead of soap, and stop the bubble baths.
findings.rationale: The note omits the instruction to use 'lots of it' when applying the moisturiser, which is a relevant detail for adherence.
